title: MECP2 Variant Spectrum and Genotype-Phenotype Correlations in Iranian Rett Syndrome Patients: Identification of a Novel Frameshift Mutation.
authors: Booalizadeh, Parnoush; Salahshourifar, Iman; Rabbani, Bahareh; Rezvani, Morteza; Ashrafi, Mahmoud Reza; Mahdieh, Nejat
one_liner_zh: 该文为伊朗Rett综合征患者的MECP2基因变异谱与基因型-表型关联研究，核心是临床遗传学与测序，仅用RoseTTAFold对新型变异做结构建模，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作机制或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Background rett syndrome (RTT) is a severe X-linked neurodevelopmental disorder primarily affecting females, predominantly caused by pathogenic variants in the MECP2 gene. This study investigates the genetic and phenotypic spectrum of RTT in Iran, a population characterized by high genetic diversity and consanguinity. Methods twenty-five Iranian RTT patients (24 females, 1 male; aged 2-17 years), including 11 newly diagnosed and 14 previously reported cases, were analyzed. Clinical evaluation, pedigree analysis, and bidirectional sequencing of all MECP2 coding exons (NM_004992.3) were performed. Variant pathogenicity was assessed using ACMG criteria and in silico tools (MutationTaster, VarSome, Franklin). Structural impact of the novel variant was modeled using RoseTTAFold. Results a novel frameshift variant, c.1268_1269insGGGCACTC; p. Leu424GlyfsTer61, was identified in exon 4 and classified as likely pathogenic. Fifteen distinct MECP2 variants were detected, with 87% pathogenic/likely pathogenic; exon 4 emerged as a mutational hotspot. All patients showed psychomotor regression, loss of purposeful hand use, and communication impairment. Common features included locomotion difficulties (96%), microcephaly (64%), seizures (60%), and abnormal EEG (64%). Truncating variants (nonsense/frameshift) correlated with severe phenotypes (e.g., quadriplegia, feeding difficulties), though statistical significance was limited by sample size (Fisher's exact test, p = 1.00). Conclusions this study reveals a distinct MECP2 mutation profile in Iranian RTT patients, including a novel pathogenic variant, and highlights genotype-phenotype associations influenced by regional genetic factors. Targeted MECP2 exon 4 sequencing is recommended for efficient diagnosis. These findings support the development of personalized diagnostic and therapeutic approaches in high-consanguinity populations and lay the foundation for future genomic and functional studies in Iran.
abstract_zh: 背景 Rett综合征（RTT）是一种严重的X连锁神经发育障碍，主要影响女性，主要由MECP2基因的致病性变异引起。本研究调查了伊朗RTT患者的遗传和表型谱，该人群以高遗传多样性和近亲婚配为特征。方法 分析了25名伊朗RTT患者（24名女性，1名男性；年龄2-17岁），包括11名新诊断和14名既往报道病例。进行了临床评估、家系分析以及所有MECP2编码外显子（NM_004992.3）的双向测序。使用ACMG标准和计算机模拟工具（MutationTaster、VarSome、Franklin）评估变异致病性。使用RoseTTAFold对新变异的 structural 影响进行建模。结果 在外显子4中鉴定出一个新的移码变异 c.1268_1269insGGGCACTC; p. Leu424GlyfsTer61，并将其分类为可能致病。检测到15种不同的MECP2变异，其中87%为致病性/可能致病性；外显子4成为突变热点。所有患者均表现出精神运动退化、有目的性手部动作丧失和沟通障碍。常见特征包括运动困难（96%）、小头畸形（64%）、癫痫发作（60%）和异常脑电图（64%）。截断变异（无义/移码）与严重表型（如四肢瘫痪、喂养困难）相关，但统计显著性受样本量限制（Fisher精确检验，p = 1.00）。结论 本研究揭示了伊朗RTT患者中独特的MECP2突变谱，包括一种新的致病性变异，并强调了受区域遗传因素影响的基因型-表型关联。建议针对MECP2外显子4进行靶向测序以实现高效诊断。这些发现支持在高近亲婚配人群中开发个性化诊断和治疗方法，并为伊朗未来的基因组和功能研究奠定基础。
